changelog:
Initial release of recursive-knowledge-miner skill.

- Introduces a 3-layer hierarchical architecture for professional knowledge extraction: core, primary, and detail.
- All responses are structured JSON objects following a strict schema for explanations, entities, and relationships.
- Implements logic to maintain a consistent, non-duplicative knowledge graph using reference checks and ID mapping.
- Provides clear protocols for entity grouping, relationship definition, and context-aware extraction.
- Details a step-by-step workflow for recursive knowledge growth and interactive graph construction.
display_name: A precision tool designed for distilling high-fidelity professional concepts and relationships from complex information. It automatically organizes knowledge into a 3-layer architecture (Core, Primary, Detail) and ensures semantic consistency through recursive entity tracking. This skill enables any AI to act as a structured knowledge engine, generating consistent, graph-ready data for interactive learning.
summary: Professional multi-layered knowledge extraction and recursive knowledge graph construction.
